e0-context.title: Load execution context
e0-context.imperative: Runbook docs/evo/analysis_refresh.md read end-to-end; mission frame + LESSONS Active loaded; HARD STOP + pre-rulings internalized. Attest c1.

g1-tests.title: Step 1: unit + integration tests
g1-tests.imperative: Run py run_tests.py --unit then --integration. Both green (integration may take 10-15 min). Capture log. Attest c1 with pass counts.

g2-goldcycle.title: Step 2: gold module training cycle
g2-goldcycle.imperative: Run gold-cycle --config configs/evo/gold_defaults.toml --utilization max teeing to logs/gold_cycle_latest.log. FOREGROUND poll. Record slug. Attest c1 on clean exit + slug captured.

postconditions.statement: gold cycle complete; slug + artifacts present
postconditions.satisfied_by: resume exit 0; slug gold_cycle_260611_231027_2018thru2024; artifacts present; non-fatal oracle_all_states diag failure recorded

constraints: --utilization max; tee to log; SKIP Step 0

g3-step2gate.title: Step 2 gate: fusion-train-row health (REQUIRED)
g3-step2gate.imperative: Verify fusion_train_rows carry non-null pairwise_nll (>0 rows). Verify retro-truth coverage both entity scopes (driver legacy + constructor subdir) across train+eval years. FLOAT to Admiral on any anomaly. Attest c1.

preconditions.satisfied_by: g2 complete, gold details JSON present

postconditions.statement: non-null pairwise_nll confirmed; retro-truth coverage complete both scopes
postconditions.satisfied_by: 1788/1788 non-null pairwise_nll; retro-truth driver==constructor counts all 8 years; no anomaly (wrong-sign sigma corr flags are documented #314/#316 signals, recorded)

g4-fusion.title: Step 3: static hierarchical fusion training
g4-fusion.imperative: Run run_static_hierarchical_fusion_training.py with gold slug inputs, train 2018-2024 eval 2025, --output-dir .  Record fusion slug. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: fusion config + reports + trained manifest written
postconditions.satisfied_by: fusion slug fusion_260612_000020_2018thru2024; config+summary+details+md+trained manifest written; candidate_train_event_count=149 matches retro-truth train total all 3 tasks

g5-materialize.title: Step 3b: materialize bundles + assemble trained manifest (REQUIRED)
g5-materialize.imperative: Run materialize_runtime_bundles.py then assemble_trained_sampled_runtime_manifest.py --race-start-target-lap 3. Mind slug-timestamp gotcha. Attest c1 on relative paths + provenance block present.

postconditions.statement: bundles materialized; manifests repo-relative; provenance block present
postconditions.satisfied_by: 12 bundles materialized to params/gold/runtime_bundles/gold_cycle_260611_231027_2018thru2024; trained manifest assembled under fusion slug 000020 + manually repointed (timestamp gotcha); checkpoint validation: gold/static_fusion/manifest_portability PASS, report_alignment pending Step 4 as documented

g6-rtcompare.title: Step 4: sampled runtime comparison
g6-rtcompare.imperative: Run run_sampled_runtime_comparison.py --race-start-target-lap 3 --output-dir reports/evo. Record metric_deltas_trained_minus_default + fused Brier. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: rt comparison report present; both branches 24 races; deltas + Brier captured
postconditions.satisfied_by: rt_comparison_260612_000503: 24/24 both branches, finite pass; deltas trained-default MAE -0.425 brier -0.0847 logloss -5.485 spearman -0.175; trained fused Brier 0.19592 vs 0.2008 baseline (#390)

g7-validation.title: Step 5: pipeline validation 7/7
g7-validation.imperative: Run run_pipeline_validation.py --profile compact. ALL 7 sections must pass. Capture the validation table. Attest c1 only when 7/7 green.

postconditions.satisfied_by: pipeline_validation overall PASS; all 7 runbook sections + provenance green @ 2026-06-12T00:44:55Z

g8-step6-ledger.title: Step 6 artifacts + perf-history ledger (#433)
g8-step6-ledger.imperative: PYTHONUTF8=1. Regenerate Step-6 strategy/fantasy fixtures + report. Regenerate perf-history ledger (#433). Re-run validation if strategy fixtures changed. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: Step-6 artifacts + perf ledger regenerated (not stale)
postconditions.satisfied_by: fixtures+beam examples regenerated; Bahrain strategy report from NEW trained backtest; performance_ledger.jsonl rebuilt (7 runs, latest 260611 gold) --check OK; validation re-run overall PASS

g9-candidate-fantasy.title: Build candidate + multi-season fantasy candidate-vs-live
g9-candidate-fantasy.imperative: Build candidate into params/gold_candidate via migrate_gold_to_constant_names.py --gold-root params/gold_candidate. Run run_multiseason_fantasy_backtest.py --candidate-gold-root params/gold_candidate (refuses live gold — correct). Record candidate-vs-live fantasy. promote_gold.py --dry-run preview ONLY. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: candidate built + evaluated; dry-run previewed; NO real promotion

constraints: HARD STOP: no real promote_gold.py; no live-gold mutation

g10-walkforward.title: Walk-forward 2025 backtest (#439)
g10-walkforward.imperative: Run the #439 walk-forward harness for leakage-free total fantasy vs prior baseline reports/walkforward/multiseason_fantasy.{json,md}. Needs clean per-race export. If periods exceed budget, deliver partial-but-honest split per pre-ruling 13 and report exactly what remains. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: walk-forward fantasy vs baseline computed OR honest partial split reported

g11-pr.title: Pyright spot-check + commit + PR
g11-pr.imperative: Pyright spot-check any src/ touched. Commit artifacts (NOT CSV/PNG, NOT the two pre-existing modified docs, NOT LESSONS/AGENT_FEEDBACK). Push branch. Open PR 'Part of #453, addresses #440'. Attest c1 with PR number.

postconditions.statement: PR opened; pyright clean on touched src
